results.raw:
When creating a URL map it’s essential to clearly distinguish between planned destinations and actual test outcomes. The map should list each old address alongside its intended new destination, helping you visualize where changes are expected. This separation allows you to track progress without confusing real results with anticipated paths. 

Testing redirects requires careful verification of each link individually. Run the old address through the system and note the final destination, then confirm whether the redirect worked as planned. Recording any failed tests is crucial for identifying issues before they affect users. This method ensures you focus on actual results rather than assumptions. 

Stay consistent in your documentation, updating the map as tests reveal new information. This approach keeps your workflow organized and reduces the risk of overlooking critical issues.

hook: test redirects thoroughly  
action: review_draft
